brief: 优化 macOS Tauri 视频下载器效果图，去掉沉重的右侧栏，形成轻量统一的桌面下载控制台。
prompt:
Create a polished high-fidelity macOS desktop application screenshot, not a website landing page. Use the supplied previous concept as a style and quality reference, but substantially simplify its information architecture. Preserve the near-black deep teal palette, subtle blue-green atmospheric glow, acid-lime accent, thin desaturated teal borders, compact typography, and precise native download-manager feeling.

Window composition at 1600x1120:
- Native macOS title bar.
- One compact application header. Brand at left. At right, one horizontal operational status cluster containing engine online status, global live speed, active task count, downloaded total, a compact restart icon action, and one settings button. The metrics should be visually light, separated by thin dividers, not enclosed in large cards.
- A slim page title row labeled 下载控制台 with filter tabs and task count.
- No right sidebar and no persistent settings panel. Settings open from the top settings button as a future modal or drawer, but the modal is not open in this screenshot.
- The full content width is a single task workspace with three compact task rows/cards: one active download, one completed item, and one failed item.
- The active task has progress bar, speed, bytes, fragments, and remaining time in one efficient line.
- The failed task shows one friendly Chinese error summary. The original technical error is hidden behind a collapsed 技术详情 row.
- Equal-height aligned primary and secondary action buttons.
- Main app window has no body scrollbar. The task list alone may imply internal vertical scrolling through a subtle clipped continuation or narrow internal indicator.
- More breathing room than a dense enterprise dashboard, but much more compact than a marketing page.

Prioritize the task content. The top status cluster should feel like a lightweight instrument panel, not a second navigation bar. Avoid redundant status cards, repeated metrics, oversized panels, and excessive borders.
instruction: Use the reference image for palette, component finish, and task-card quality. Remove its right column entirely and redistribute only essential live metrics into the top header.

require: settings represented by one top button
all controls visible in one viewport
